name: hello_mcp
description: hello_mcp exposes a remote tool API as tools. At load it GETs <url>/tools ([{name, description, schema}]) and registers each as hello_mcp__<name>; calls POST <url>/tools/<name> with the JSON args. For real MCP servers use the built-in tool_mcp plugin; this template shows how to adapt any HTTP tool API the same way.
